purpose: Test geometric R75 endpoints 42/50/60 degrees selected from the prior measured mapping to realize approximately 35/45/55 degree ball takeoff. This is a geometry diagnostic, not a material or speed selection.

criteria.name: nip_capture
criteria.rule: ball crosses launcher local X=-33 mm without plough

criteria.name: ski_takeoff
criteria.rule: ball clears the selected ski tip toward -X

criteria.name: d5065_contact_current
criteria.rule: absolute current during ball-wheel contact <=20 A per motor

criteria.name: d5065_contact_torque
criteria.rule: absolute torque during ball-wheel contact <=0.62 N m per motor

criteria.name: forbidden_contact
criteria.rule: no ball or launcher contact with chassis, arch, camera or LiDAR

criteria.name: finite_state
criteria.rule: no NaN or Inf in telemetry

diagnostics_only: highest ball top relative to LiDAR Z390
